subject.title: fix(anthropic): restrict OAuth callback host to loopback addresses and derive redirect URI

question: Should OpenClaw accept loopback-only Anthropic OAuth callback validation now, including rejecting non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values during Anthropic login?
rationale: The patch is a narrow, source-backed fix, but it intentionally changes shipped auth-provider env behavior and the security framing depends on trusted-operator environment assumptions.

options.title: Accept Loopback-Only Callback Hosts
options.body: Approve the fail-closed loopback allowlist and derived redirect URI because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape.

options.title: Require Live Provider Exchange Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Anthropic token exchange before accepting provider-side redirect registration risk for 127.0.0.1 and ::1 spellings.

options.title: Pause Anthropic OAuth Direction
options.body: Hold or close the PR if maintainers prefer deprecating or removing the direct Anthropic OAuth helper instead of hardening it.

recommendation.title: Accept Loopback-Only Callback Hosts
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed loopback allowlist and derived redirect URI because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape.
